9fe6716f7bff41b986c467afc82c6c357fb19baf.summary: Fortinet's 2014 analysis, republished from Virus Bulletin, describes the Andromeda modular botnet. The loader fetches modules and updates from its C&C server, uses anti-VM and anti-debug checks, injects into trusted processes and sets up autostart. Version 2.06 is the latest official build. Modules include a form grabber, a ring3 rootkit and a SOCKS4 proxy. The bot can also distribute other malware, including ZeroAccess, Kelihos and FakeAV.

9f050b8452d7b63e4d794f66cc4f6c525c51b3a3.summary: BleepingComputer's December 2021 report on the ALPHV BlackCat ransomware-as-a-service operation. The Rust-written ransomware is configurable, offers several encryption modes, can spread across a network using domain credentials and PSExec, and terminates backup and database processes. Affiliates earn revenue shares of 80 to 90 percent. Victims in the USA, Australia and India were reported, with ransom demands of $400,000 to $3 million. Extortion includes data theft and DDoS threats. The report says BlackCat is likely to fill the gap left by BlackMatter and REvil.
